issues.description: The solution query for Aufgabe 02 (solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql) returns an extra attribute (Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel) that is not requested by the problem statement. The problem explicitly asks for the names and streets of all Freizeitparks and the names of the respective Gemeinde; the exercise instructions also state to "Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr." The extra column in the solution contradicts that requirement and may confuse students about the expected output.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to output only the requested columns: SELECT Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, Gemeinde.name ... (remove Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel). Alternatively, if the gemeindeschluessel column is intentionally required, update the problem statement to list it explicitly.
